display.purpose: Page hero H1 (112px home, 96px /aem, 64px docs); carries one amber italic phrase.

title.purpose: Card H3 headings under mono eyebrows (18–22px).

body.purpose: Prose at 15–18px/1.6, muted via 72–78% alpha of the ground's text color.

label.purpose: Uppercase SF Mono eyebrows/tags at +0.22–0.24em; also the nav pill and /docs/commands 40px command headings.

narrative.overview: A dark editorial two-ground composition: deep ink navy alternating with warm cream in full-bleed bands, one amber accent doing every chromatic job. Type-only heroes at 96–112px over a radial ink glow and CSS starfield; SF Mono uppercase eyebrows mark every section; surfaces are flat, separated by 1px dust-alpha hairlines rather than shadows. Docs pages invert to cream with an ink sidebar without changing the vocabulary.
keyCharacteristics: Two grounds (ink / cream), one accent (amber), zero other hues
Type-only heroes with starfield texture; flat, nearly shadowless surfaces
SF Mono as a structural voice (eyebrows, labels, nav pill, command headings)
Amber italic emphasis as the signature move inside display headings
System font stacks throughout — no webfont files ship

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Amber is the only saturated hue on the site; every other color is a navy or the cream.

rules.name: The Ad-hoc Scale
rules.body: Captured heading sizes fit no single modular ratio; per-page pairings are internally consistent, the cross-page scale is not.

rules.name: The Hairline-Not-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Cards separate from their ground with a 1px rgba(245,240,230,.08) border and a lighter navy fill — never a drop shadow.

dos: Do keep amber (#e8b95e) as the single accent and spend it on one emphasis per composition.
Do alternate full-bleed ink (#0a1024) and cream (#f5f0e6) grounds.
Do mark structure with SF Mono uppercase eyebrows at +0.22–0.24em tracking.
Do separate surfaces with 1px dust-alpha hairlines, not shadows.
Do set heroes as pure type over the radial ink glow + starfield.
donts: Don't use "gradient blob hero, glassmorphism, generic icon trios" — the site's own named anti-toolbox.
Don't deliver "the average" / shelf-component sameness — "sites got fast by getting boring".
Don't introduce a second saturated hue.
Don't add drop shadows to cards or buttons.
Don't load webfonts — the captured system runs entirely on system stacks.
